newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares trade tight to close flat.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares trade tight to close flat.

text.p: Greek equities ended virtually unchanged after tight trade in moderate volume continuing to focus on the election campaign and analysts said the benchmark share index woud stay channel bound between 920-950 points.

"The recent rally gave rise to profits which were eventually taken. The market is forming a new base at current levels but we don't see volatility ahead until we are over the elections. Stocks will stay in the 920-950 channel," said fund manager Vassilis Kaloudis at Hambros Hellenic.

"It seems that the gap is narrowing, the socialist party started strong buts its lead has come down and this will cast a wet blanket on stocks during this period. If it recaptures its lead during the campaign the market will welcome the news," he said.
Kaloudis who manages Hambros 3.2 billion drachma Construction and Infrastructure fund said the more volatile, higher beta construction sector would move in line with the broad market.
He favoured shares of Alte, Aktor, Terna and Diekat on strong earnings growth.

The Athens general share index closed 0.09 percent, or 0.88 points higher at 933.22 from Thursday's 932.34 close after opening at 932.26 points. Turnover eased to 6.26 billion drachmas on volume of 3.64 million shares.
In line with market expectations, August CPI inflation slowed to 8.5 percent year-on-year from 8.6 percent in July, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said.
Bankers and economists had forecast August inflation would ease to 8.5 percent year-on-year in an earlier Reuters informal poll.
Greece will hold early elections September 22.

Advancers led decliners 116 to 88 with 37 issues unchanged on 241 traded. Banks closed flat, up 0.02 percent, industrials firmed 0.18 percent with construction gaining 0.40 percent. Small-caps slipped 0.06 percent.

The Merrill Lynch call spread warrant on OTE with a strike price of 3,800 drachmas was quoted at 556-574 at the close. Shares of OTE telecom, the underlying, ended up 15 drachmas at 4,025 in light trade.

The recently launched Merrill Lynch stock index call warrant based on a basket of 23 shares was quoted lower at 200.60-211.20 drachmas. It expires on January 9 1998 with a strike price of 1000. It was in the money at 1023.3.
The Morgan Stanley Hellenic Blue Chip Warrant, which has a strike price of 100 marks, was quoted at 3,531-3,759 drachmas at the close.
